content.summary: Mechanical BUILD-stage evidence for case mew-migration: 5 contract decision(s) honoured with digested source evidence, 28 defaulted with a written disclosure, 0 contradicted, and 0 emergent decisions surfaced by a receipted sweep of 376 tracked files. Every evidence entry is a real file with a digest and a generation record; nothing in this pack is asserted.

primaryArtifact.how: The artifact exists as committed code bound to the real Mew model: the Convex schema for nodes/relations/relationTypes/relationLists with provenance columns and by_sourceId erasure indexes, the importer whose manifest closes per table with counted drops, the filesystem store mirror with enumerateForErasure walking every table including endpoint-touching relations, the agent surface that renders unbound without a binding, and the fixture-run import manifest produced by executing the importer.

elements.how: The importer accepts exactly the shape Mew's own exporter writes — {data, users, graphNodes, graphRelations, relationTypes, relationLists} — with field sets taken from personal-dev-mew src/db/schema.ts, and is unit-tested only against the labeled fixture file whose every id is prefixed 'fixture:'; the manifest records fixtureLabeled true, read from the file's own label, and binds the expected shape to the recon-digested schema and exporter.

elements.how: Schema drift refuses loudly: a record carrying latest-main's contentText/relationCount (or any field outside the bound personal-dev-mew field sets) is refused with the drift named in the reason, and the scenario suite asserts exactly that refusal while the table still closes.

Dedup is implemented by id within one export, mirroring the source's unique(id, author_id): the first occurrence is kept and every duplicate is a loud manifest refusal, never a merge. The scenario suite covers the duplicate-id refusal and the table still closing.

Drops are explicit and counted: droppedTables records data and users with row counts and reasons, fieldDrops records pk and contentTsvector with reasons, dangling relation endpoints are flagged on the row and counted in the manifest, and the scenario suite asserts all of it; the fixture-run manifest shows users(1) dropped and danglingRelations 1 with zero silent drops.

emergentSweep.method: Mechanical inventory: every tracked file under the scanned paths was enumerated by a receipted git ls-files run. The producer surfaced no emergent decisions because it does not read semantics; the receipt shows exactly what was and was not searched.
knownBlindSpots: The sweep enumerates file paths only; a decision expressed inside code, copy, or a configuration value does not appear.
Untracked files are invisible to git ls-files and were not inventoried.

evidence.boundary: Shows what the contract says, not that any of it was built. Reconciliation dispositions carry that burden separately.

claimed: All 33 decision-bearing contract pointers carry an explicit disposition; none is silently honoured and none is omitted.
The inputs[0] binding digest was recomputed from the canonical JSON of the contract actually read, via the same canonicalSha256 the chain gate uses.
The emergent-decision sweep ran as a real command (exit 0) and its receipt lists all 376 files inventoried.
The configured test command was executed and its exit code (0) recorded exactly as it happened.
notRun: No semantic assessment of the built system against any contract decision was performed by this producer; every pointer without caller-supplied evidence is recorded as defaulted-with-disclosure, not honoured.
No human has read the disclosure artifact; it exists on disk with a digest, and nothing more is claimed for it.
The emergent sweep inventoried tracked file paths only; decisions expressed inside code semantics, copy, or configuration values were not searched for.

refused.item: Marking any contract decision honoured without caller-supplied evidence files
refused.reason: An honoured disposition asserts the build did something specific, and this producer cannot see intent — only bytes and exit codes. Where no evidence was supplied it defaulted with disclosure instead.
Authorization is derived by verification from an attestation. A producer granting it to itself is the self-approval the authority model forbids, so the field is pinned false.
